literal: Klingon has one pronoun for both
one pronoun for he and she
chaH of people; bIH of things
goes on the noun: -wI' if it can speak
goes on the noun: -lI' if it can speak
approach / proceed; takes the destination as object
goes on the verb: vIjatlhnIS = I need to speak
verb first: qalegh vIneH = I want to see you
thing first: bIQ vIneH = I want water
goes on the noun: Dochvam = this thing
goes on the noun: Dochvetlh = that thing
goes on the verb: QaQqu' = very good
